stages.name: OBSERVE
stages.requiredEvidence: Source identity, observed-at time, provenance, tenant scope
stages.acceptanceInvariant: A source-backed observation exists and is attributable; stale or missing input is explicit.

stages.name: UNDERSTAND
stages.authority: Canonical context and mission understanding services
stages.requiredEvidence: Normalized context, constraints, uncertainty and source references
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Unknowns remain explicit; inferred facts are not presented as verified facts.

stages.name: PLAN
stages.authority: Canonical mission planner and capability/resource contracts
stages.requiredEvidence: Plan version, required capabilities/resources, constraints, feasibility result
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Plan is reproducible and respects policy, time, capacity and resource constraints.

stages.name: EVALUATE
stages.requiredEvidence: Evaluation version, risk findings, policy decisions and blockers
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Rejected or blocked plans cannot advance as accepted plans.

stages.name: ACCEPT
stages.requiredEvidence: Decision, actor or governed policy, timestamp, referenced plan
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Acceptance is explicit and bound to the exact plan version.

stages.name: AUTHORIZE
stages.requiredEvidence: Actor, tenant scope, capability, target resource, decision and audit reference
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Authorization is checked server-side for the exact action and current scope.

stages.name: PREPARE
stages.requiredEvidence: Preflight checks, resource readiness, dependencies and blockers
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Execution cannot begin with unmet required preconditions.

stages.name: ASSIGN
stages.requiredEvidence: Executor/resource identity, assignment version, acceptance and scope
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Only one authoritative assignment applies; stale/conflicting assignments are rejected.

stages.name: EXECUTE
stages.authority: Mission Execution Coordinator and canonical action registry
stages.requiredEvidence: Command/action ID, idempotency key, actor, timestamps and execution status
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Commands use governed contracts; retries do not create duplicate effects.

stages.name: EFFECT
stages.requiredEvidence: Effect reference, source type, observation time and provenance
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Simulation, sandbox, SIL, HIL and physical effect are never conflated.

stages.name: VERIFY
stages.requiredEvidence: Evidence references, verifier, criteria, result and timestamp
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Success requires evidence meeting the mission-specific verification criteria.

stages.name: RECOVER
stages.authority: Existing execution recovery and reconciliation authorities
stages.requiredEvidence: Failure classification, recovery action, owner, attempts and reconciliation state
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Unknown execution outcomes enter explicit reconciliation/waiting, not assumed success.

stages.name: OUTCOME
stages.requiredEvidence: Outcome, evidence references, reason codes and mission version
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Outcome follows verified/reconciled truth and cannot overwrite newer truth.

stages.name: LEARN
stages.requiredEvidence: Verified outcome reference, model/weight version, confidence and deferral decision
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Learning uses verified outcomes only and cannot override canonical truth or authorization.

stages.name: NEXT SITUATION
stages.purpose: Valid next action or waiting condition
stages.authority: Existing Next Situation Engine and liveness guard
stages.requiredEvidence: Next-action/waiting state, owner, due time or escalation and source mission
stages.acceptanceInvariant: Every non-terminal mission has a valid next action or explicit waiting condition.

stages.name: OBSERVE — NEXT CYCLE
stages.purpose: Next observation begins a new cycle
stages.requiredEvidence: Predecessor outcome, new observation reference and cycle correlation
stages.acceptanceInvariant: New cycle links to predecessor without erasing mission history or prior evidence.

notCertified: Device-specific supervised HIL and emergency-stop proof
